verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a corporate finance SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows a REST API, machine-readable docs (llms.txt, Markdown pages) and AI-generated alerts and insights. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented natural-language command interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
